draft_key_information_units.information: Q2 and 6-month headline financial performance showed revenue of EUR 4,503k (Q2) and EUR 11,439k (6m) with profit before tax at EUR -234k (Q2) and EUR 186k (6m), reflecting impact of one-off IPO and dividend-related costs.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report overview and consolidated statements

draft_key_information_units.information: Sales activity remained strong with 57 contracts signed in Q2 (111 in 6m), presale portfolio reaching EUR 48.6m, and weekly sales ratio exceeding 3.1% in Q2.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Overview of second quarter and six months

draft_key_information_units.information: Initial public offering completed in April-May 2026 raising EUR 4,932k, shares listed on Nasdaq Tallinn on 15 May 2026, EUR 1,362k dividends paid, and new share options issued.
Berlin development portfolio expanded with acquisitions of Plantagenstraße 19 (EUR 1.7m) and Reichstraße 101 (EUR 1.2m) properties for residential projects.
Liquidity increased with cash and cash equivalents at EUR 10,033k, construction loans reached EUR 16,561k, and equity ratio stood at 26.7% as of 30 June 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position and cash flow

draft_key_information_units.information: Twelve homes were handed over in Q2 2026 and total of 26 homes/commercial units completed in the first half, down from 35 and 41 in same period 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Overview of second quarter and six months

draft_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting period acquisition of Pärnu maantee 35/37/41 properties in Tallinn for EUR 10m, planning over 160 residential and commercial units.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after the reporting period section

draft_key_information_units.information: Liven held over 8% market share in Greater Tallinn during 6 months 2026 with active sales listings in new developments.
Outlook indicates nearly 90% of 2026 EUR 59m revenue target covered, net profit expected to increase and exceed 20% ROE target, with construction planned for five new project phases in H2.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units cover prioritized material themes: headline financial performance (D1), major sales/presale drivers (D2), strategic capital developments including IPO and Berlin expansion (D3-D4), liquidity/capital position (D5), operational completions (D6), material post-period acquisition (D7), market context (D8), and forward outlook (D9). Excludes routine boilerplate such as governance details, accounting policies, and generic risk lists. Each unit represents an independently omittable theme supported by source evidence, with approximately 9 units as requested.
